d6-6.approach: Adjust foodSurplus, compare multiple feasible outcomes and observe changes in other systems.
d6-6.reflection: Which trade-offs did you make for food production? Would an earlier decision improve the outcome?
d6-6.hintEasy: Start with foodSurplus (kg/year), change it gradually and observe the effect.
d6-6.hintHard: Test sensitivity to foodSurplus, quantify uncertainty and document downstream effects.
